To, Se
All State/UT Drugs Controllers,
Sub: Incorporation of Losartan associated muscle spasm in the
prescribing information leaflet- Reg.
Sir/Madam,
The National Co-ordination Centre for Pharmacovigilance Programme of India
(NCC-PvPI), functioning at IPC Ghaziabad has_ forwarded _ their
recommendation based on ADR reports on certain medicinal products
including Losartan which were discussed by them in the 22" Signal Review
Panel (SRP) under the programme meeting held on on 22.11.2022 with an
objective to detect Signal/Prescribing Information Leaflet change from Indian
database and promote patient safety.
In the meeting, the PvPI has evaluated the reported ADRs for Losartan on the
basis of Individual Case Study Reports (ICSR) and recommended CDSCO to
take necessary steps to incorporate Muscle spasm as an adverse drug
reaction in to the Prescribing information leaflet (PIL) of the Losartan marketed
in the country.
Subsequently, the PvPI recommendations was deliberated in the Subject
Expert Committee (SEC-Cardiovascular & Renal) meeting held on 11.01.2023
at CDSCO (HQ), New Delhi. After detailed deliberation, the Committee
recommended that CDSCO should request the State Drugs Controller to
instruct the manufacturers of the drug to include Muscle spasm as an adverse
drug reaction in the PIL of Losartan marketed in India.
1

The recommendation of the SEC has been considered by this office.
Accordingly, you are requested to direct the manufacturers of Losartan
formulations under your jurisdiction to mention Muscle spasm as an adverse
drug reaction in the Package insert/Promotional Literature of the drug.
Action taken in this regard may be intimated to this office.
Yours faithfully,
bs
—_—
Dr. V.G Somani
Drugs Controller General (India)
